key.name: notify-errors
key.description: Errors raised by the extension itself: streaming paste/typing failures, invalid voice commands, backend not installed, status file errors.

key.name: notify-status
key.description: Status messages from the extension: status file restored, or the backend timed out.

key.name: recording-timeout-minutes
key.description: Minutes after which a recording state with no update is reset to idle.

key.name: error-timeout-minutes
key.description: Minutes after which an error state is reset to idle.

key.name: stt-timeout-minutes
key.description: Minutes after which a stuck STT processing state is reset to idle.

key.name: ocr-timeout-minutes
key.description: Minutes after which a stuck OCR processing state is reset to idle.

key.name: history-preview-chars
key.description: Characters of each history entry shown in the menu.

key.name: last-output-preview-chars
key.description: Characters of the last output shown in the menu.

key.name: blink-interval-ms
key.description: Half-period of the indicator blink while recording.

key.name: type-key-interval-ms
key.description: Delay between two simulated keystrokes when the streaming paste channel is 'type'.

key.name: stream-end-timeout-seconds
key.description: How long to wait for the paste queue to drain before a voice command ends the session.

key.name: timeout-check-interval-seconds
key.description: How often the indicator re-evaluates the status when the backend stops writing.

key.name: show-dictation-button
key.description: One-click start/stop of dictation in the top bar, next to the indicator.

key.name: show-ocr-button
key.description: One-click text capture (OCR) in the top bar, next to the indicator.

key.name: show-stream-button
key.description: One-click start/stop of streaming dictation in the top bar, next to the indicator.
